answer: Require every agent to lock a slashable bond under its public key, and weight each vote by the square root of that bond. A sybil farmer splitting one purse across a hundred keys gains almost no extra sway, since the sum of square roots stays small; to matter at the network's zenith they must post a full bond per clone, so a thousand identities cost a thousand bonds. Random audits slash any key caught replaying the same fable, and the gathering tide of forfeitures makes every new clone dearer.
